status: PRE-REGISTERED before any model or benchmark error was computed (extraction and integrity checks only)

target.name: ITMG blended realised ASP (USD/t), standalone quarter, FIRST-REPORTED value from the quarter's own analyst presentation
target.why_not_export_ASP: export-only ASP is not consistently disclosed 2018Q1-2026Q3; blended ASP (incl. post-shipment adjustments and traded coal) is the defined target; domestic share is handled as a covariate (M4), not silently substituted
target.revisions: later decks revise ASP (post-shipment adjustments, e.g. 2024Q2 94.0 -> 95.8); first-reported values are used for targets AND lags

forecast_origin: 10 calendar days after quarter end (World Bank CMO monthly prices for the quarter's last month are published ~2nd business day of the next month; ITMG reports the quarter >= 3 weeks later). Horizon: nowcast of the just-ended quarter, before the company report.
information_set: CMO 'Coal, Australian' (Newcastle) monthly through the quarter's last month (single vintage downloaded 2026-11-24; revision risk documented); ITMG first-reported ASP and destination domestic share for quarters reported before the origin (q-1 and earlier).

definitions.N_q: mean of the 3 monthly Newcastle prices of quarter q
definitions.N1_q: mean of the 3 monthly Newcastle prices lagged one month (e.g. Dec-Feb for Q1)
definitions.s_q: domestic (Indonesia) share of sales volume printed in the quarter's deck; s_(q-1) used at the origin; missing -> last available

benchmarks.B5_rolling_discount: N_q x mean(ASP/N over the last 4 reported quarters)
benchmarks.B6_lagged_newc_reg: OLS ASP_t = a + b N_(t-1), expanding window from 2018Q1 (min 8 obs); forecast a + b N_(q-1)

strongest_benchmark: the benchmark with the lowest MAE on the common test sample (conservative: chosen ex post among the 6)

candidate_models.M1_fixed_lag: ASP(q-1) x N1_q / N1_(q-1)  (one-month contract lag, full pass-through; no estimation)
candidate_models.M2_distributed_lag: dlogASP_q = a + b0 dlogN_q + b1 dlogN_(q-1), OLS expanding window (min 12 obs); forecast ASP(q-1) x exp(fitted)
candidate_models.M3_product_mix: NOT TESTABLE: calorific-value mix is not consistently disclosed (registered as not estimable; no proxy will be substituted)
candidate_models.M4_dom_export_decomposition: ASP_t = k (1 - s_t) N_t + D s_t (no intercept), OLS expanding window (min 12 obs); forecast with s_(q-1) and N_q

lags: fixed ex ante as above; no lag search on any sample
training: expanding window from 2018Q1; regressions require >= 12 (M2, M4) or >= 8 (B6) observations
evaluation_period: common sample where all 6 benchmarks and M1, M2, M4 exist; expected 2021Q2-2026Q3 (22 quarters)
metrics: MAE improvement vs strongest benchmark and vs each benchmark
OOS R2 vs B3 and vs strongest benchmark
directional accuracy: sign(forecast - ASP(q-1)) == sign(actual - ASP(q-1))
90% CI of MAE ratio (moving-block bootstrap, block 4, 5000 reps, seed 20261125)
inference: Diebold-Mariano on absolute loss, Newey-West lag floor(n^(1/3)), Harvey-Leybourne-Newbold correction, one-sided (model better)
multiple_comparisons: Holm across the 3 testable models (M1, M2, M4) vs the strongest benchmark
pass_rule: n >= 16 AND MAE(model) <= 0.85 x MAE(strongest benchmark) AND Holm-adjusted one-sided DM p <= 0.05
economic_materiality: translate the MAE reduction vs the strongest benchmark into revenue (x median verified quarterly sales volume) and EBITDA (x (1 - 0.135) royalty approximation); material if the MAE reduction >= 2% of the median ASP of the test sample

classification.GO: a model passes AND is economically material
classification.CONDITIONAL_GO: a model passes but is not material, OR passes with bootstrap CI upper bound >= 1.0 (requires prospective confirmation)
classification.NO_GO: no model passes; stop the pilot, preserve results, no retrospective specification search

next_if_pass: separate pre-registered production-volume and unit-cost experiment
change_policy: no change after results; variants require new registration and prospective evaluation
